How do I back up Microsoft 365 with XcellHost?

Let me find the information about backing up Microsoft 365 with XcellHost for you. One moment, please.

Searched for "Microsoft 365 backup"

XcellHost offers backup solutions for Microsoft 365 under its "SaaS Backup & Disaster Recovery" services. The process involves identifying the platform (Microsoft 365 in this case), the data you want to protect, user count, as well as retention & recovery requirements. XcellHost's Cloud Backup service retains recoverable copies of your data, while Disaster Recovery ensures broader continuity by restoring applications & operations after disruptions. Depending on your needs, you may require either or both services for comprehensive protection.

You can learn more about these services & how they can protect your Microsoft 365 data on XcellHost's website: SaaS Backup & Disaster Recovery.
